- DPA/processor terms + right-to-audit language; your legal team will want a review cycle and redlines

1) Completed SOC 2 Type II summary and list of control mappings (summary doc) — see attached SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (worksheet: controls_map).
2) A 48-72 hour sample export of audit logs (anonymized) showing event types and retention meta — audit-log-sample.csv attached.
3) Pen test report summary (we will redact sensitive exploit details) — we9ll provide a PDF summary by end of day tomorrow.
4) Draft DPA with our standard processor clauses for your legal team; please expect a DocuSign link after internal review.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Tue 6/22: Redwood sends redacted pen-test summary + DPA draft to your legal (we will CC the security contacts)
- Wed 6/23: 30-min follow-up with Silverline security to walk through audit-log format and retention controls (suggest 10:00 AM PT)

Are there any additional artifacts your auditors will require beyond SOC 2 report, audit-log export, pen-test summary, and DPA? I can add them to the list.

Priyom —

Appreciate the thorough recap. That matches what we discussed. A couple of clarifying asks from our side: 

1) Retention windows: Can you confirm whether we can configure retention at the event-type level (we need to keep authentication/authorization logs 7 years, but metrics/traces can be shorter). Also want to confirm deletion workflow for account-termination requests.

2) Audit logs: The sample looks good; for auditors we9ll need verifyable immutability (e.g., signed timestamps or append-only exports). Do you support signed exports or an external log archive option?

3) Pen test: Our InfoSec will want to see the last 2 pen tests, or at minimum a summarized timeline of findings and remediation dates. Redacted details are fine.

4) DPA: Jessica (cc9d) will coordinate legal. We9ll aim to send redlines within two weeks after we review.

We9re available for the follow-up Wed 6/23 at 10:00 AM PT. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

Lena Ortiz
Director, Compliance & Controls | Silverline Financial

Hi all —

Quick technical responses to the asks so Silverline can validate with auditors: 

- Retention configuration: Redwood supports per-event-type retention policies scoped at the tenant level. We can configure custom retention windows and retention classes (hot/warm/cold). For account-termination, we offer a staged deletion workflow (soft-delete + 30-day quarantine + permanent purge) and can provide signed deletion attestations for audit requests.

- Audit logs: We provide append-only audit exports and an HMAC-signed bundle option for exported archives (SHA256) so you can validate integrity externally. We can also stream copies to your cloud archive (S3/GCS) with object immutability policies if you prefer. Sample export attached (audit-log-sample.csv).

- Pen test evidence: We completed an external pen test in Q1 2027 and an internal red-team in Q4 2026. For RFPs/audits we provide (a) a redacted executive summary of findings and remediation dates, and (b) an attestation letter where appropriate. Attached is a short summary (pen-test-report-summary.pdf). Full vendor report requires an NDA in some cases; let us know if you need the full file.

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (reporting period Jan-Jun 2027). The SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx includes a control mapping sheet and the auditor contact info if auditors want direct confirmation.

I9ve attached the pen-test summary and can join the Wed 6/23 call to run through technical specifics.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
